HTML_TAGS

Frozen html element tag-name map — sole declaration site for these tokens; consumers read members and never re-declare the strings (zero-hardcoding rules 4–5). Object.freeze makes the token contract immutable at runtime.

HTML_PHRASING_TAGS

Frozen phrasing/text-bearing host map — elements whose textContent would absorb an injected sibling text node, polluting the host's accessible name and visible-text extraction. Sole declaration site for these tags; strings shared with HTML_TAGS are referenced, not redeclared (zero-hardcoding rules 4–5).
